none: PAS FindID 1000443: Lin-DA9ED6: Roman nummus of Constantine

A complete and worn, copper-alloy Roman nummus of the House of Constantine - CONSTANTINOPOLIS / Victory on prow. Probably Mint of Trier, AD 330-331 (Reece Period 17). RIC VII, p. 215, no. 530. Obverse description: Helmeted, cuirassed, bust, left. Obverse inscription: [CONSTAN-TINO]P[OLIS]. Reverse description: Victory on prow with sceptre and shield. Diameter: 15.61 mm; Thickness: 1.76 mm;…
